UserStatus.description: Whether a user may use the app.

password.description: Sets a new password, signing the user out everywhere.

Version.description: A file of the item, with what's in it.

container.description: `mp4`, `webm`, `mkv`, or ffprobe's own name for anything else.

source.description: Where it comes from: a provider (`tmdb`), `user`, or `smart`/`manual` for playlists.

best_height.description: Height of the best present file (upgrades), and the cutoff it must reach.

external_ids.description: Provider IDs, so acquisition tools can look the item up.

oneOf.description: Number in the series' default ordering.

statuses.description: Current external statuses (stale ones included, flagged).

event_types.description: Event types delivered; empty means all.

from_start.description: Start from the oldest kept event instead of now (create only).

rescanning.description: Roots rescanned because the payload named paths in them.
